notes: Fixed: uploading an APK while “Install unknown apps” is off crashed the panel app (the UniFi Display has no settings screen for it); the app details page now opens instead so the permission can be granted on the wall.
Fixed: the 1.0.305 stream self-heal could reload a stalled camera stream without actually re-fetching it, so a stalled frontdoor stream stayed black forever — reloads now force a real stream restart.

When the camera popup opens on a person detection, the frontdoor stream is verified within a few seconds: if it is frozen, it restarts immediately instead of waiting up to 35 seconds for the background watchdog.
A camera frame that has not started playing now shows the loading spinner instead of a pure black rectangle.
Frontdoor and garage camera streams now recover by themselves after a camera or go2rtc dropout — a stalled or dead stream reloads within seconds instead of showing a black frame.
Opening the camera popup on a person detection retries the live stream immediately, so detection is visible right away even after a drop.
New Wake sensitivity setting (Entrance): pick Low, Normal or High for how easily movement in front of the tablet wakes the screen — applies live, no restart needed.
Wake detection is more sensitive than before by default, so a person at the door no longer has to wave around.
Entrance wall now sleeps when nobody stands in front of it: the screen blanks about 90 s after the last movement and wakes on movement or touch.
Living-room occupancy no longer keeps the entrance panel awake; only motion in front of it counts.
Greatroom stays always-on as before; the timeout can be changed in Settings anytime.
Door-triggered camera popup opens faster: streams stay pre-warmed and the display wake is retried if it doesn't flip on.
Resuming a warm camera no longer re-prepares the player, so the first frame is quicker.
Camera streams nobody is viewing are released after a minute; wall cameras stay warm for instant door popups.
Backyard person cameras use the timeline column only (half-width, 16:9) instead of a strip above the rooms.
Timeline returns when no backyard cameras are active.
Music Discover recovers after search errors and transient Music Assistant failures.
MASS requests retry on HTTP 5xx; incomplete Discover shelves reload on tab re-entry.
Backyard cameras moved into the right-hand activity column under the timeline.
Music Discover: cached cover art, media-type search chips, and Apple Music browse with See all.
Whole-house fan toggle on the hallway popup and home chip.
Larger vision clip popup with keyframe preview.
